$comment: Copy to the repo ROOT as .atlassian-sync.json and fill in. This is the per-repo binding between local files and Atlassian. Commit it (no secrets here) so the mapping travels between machines.
cloudId: REQUIRED - the Atlassian cloudId. Resolve once with the MCP tool getAccessibleAtlassianResources and paste the id here.

jira.$epicStrategy_note: 'parent' for team-managed projects (epic = parent issue). Company-managed projects may need an Epic Link customfield id instead; the skill detects this via getJiraProjectIssueTypesMetadata.
jira.$syncLabel_note: Marker label put on every issue this skill creates. Used for search-before-create dedup and for JQL roll-ups. Do not reuse for anything else.
jira.$repoLabel_note: Optional. Set when MORE THAN ONE repo shares this Jira project (multi-repo project). Each repo gets a distinct label, e.g. repo-frontend / repo-backend, so issues are attributable to a repo. Leave null for a single-repo project.
jira.$boardId_note: Optional. Set if you want sprint awareness (which sprint an issue belongs to / active sprint).

confluence.rootPageId: REQUIRED - id of the parent page under which this repo's docs mirror tree is built (e.g. a page titled 'Docs: <repo>'). For a multi-repo project, give each repo its own docs-root page under a shared space.

session.handoffPageId: REQUIRED - id of the living 'Session Log / Working State' page for this project.
session.$machineName_note: 'auto' = derive from hostname. Identifies which computer wrote each session entry.
